name: paperhug
description: CLI-first print-at-home greeting card generator with prompt-only and AI image provider workflows.

scripts.build: node --check src/cli.js && npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile
scripts.smoke: node src/cli.js quick birthday --for Test --message cheerful --provider none --out tmp/smoke --force
scripts.package:smoke: test -f src/cli.js && test -f src/index.js && test -f templates/occasions.json && test -f skills/paperhug-card/SKILL.md && npm pack --dry-run
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run check:apps && npm run dependency:audit && npm run dependency:audit:all && npm run smoke && npm run package:smoke
scripts.check:apps: npm run build:web && npm run build:mobile

author: Roger Chappel
